description.value: Meyer Family Vineyards is an award-winning Okanagan Falls winery recognized as a Top 3 Winery in Canada at the 2025 National Wine Awards, producing about 8,000 cases of Burgundian-style Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from hand-harvested grapes. Operating since 2006, the winery has a tasting room and wine shop where visitors can sample and purchase critically acclaimed small-lot wines. It sits along McLean Creek Road in the heart of BC wine country, making it a natural destination stop on a cycling tour of the Okanagan Valley.
